title: astragalus geyeri var. triquetrus
intro: Astragalus geyeri var. triquetrus, commonly known as Geyer's milkvetch, is a perennial legume plant that belongs to the Astragalus genus. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus geyeri var. triquetrus are attributed to its ability to stimulate the production of white blood cells, increase antioxidant defenses, and enhance the body's natural response to stress and disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic properties.
